mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 0.5% month-over-month and GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive, it signals robust economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS MoM growth > 0.5% and GDPC1 growth > 0%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS and GDPC1 meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a decline in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 5%.
